primary_title: The p75 receptor acts as a displacement factor that releases Rho from Rho-GDI
decision_basis: Primary supports exact p75NTR-RhoGDI association and bounded RhoA-release/growth-cone function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve p75 death-domain/RhoGDI interface, neurotrophin or myelin-ligand state, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: TRAF family proteins interact with the common neurotrophin receptor and modulate apoptosis induction
decision_basis: Primary maps p75NTR association with TRAF2 and bounded death/NF-kappaB modulation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve p75 oligomer state and adaptor-interaction mapping; no universal TRAF2 relay or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Association of the p75 neurotrophin receptor with TRAF6; Neurotrophin signaling through the p75 receptor is deficient in traf6-/- mice
decision_basis: Primary supports NGF-dependent p75NTR-TRAF6 association and bounded NF-kappaB/JNK-related function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NGF dependence, p75 juxtamembrane interaction and cell-type-specific outputs; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Identification of interleukin 1 receptor-associated kinase as a conserved component in the p75-neurotrophin receptor activation of nuclear factor-kappa B
decision_basis: Primary supports NGF-dependent p75NTR-IRAK1 association with p62/TRAF6/IKKbeta pathway function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NGF dependence and intermediary p62/TRAF6/IKKbeta context; no terminal-TF or SCI inference.

primary_title: TRAF6-mediated ubiquitination regulates nuclear translocation of NRIF, the p75 receptor interactor
decision_basis: Primary supports K63-linked TRAF6 ubiquitination of NRIF in p75-activated cellular and neuronal systems.
limitations_preserved: Preserve K63-linked NRIF ubiquitination, p75 activation and traf6-null neuronal context; nuclear localization is not a terminal-TF inference.
